  • a) Provides a structured and systematic learning environment.

questions.question: Evaluate the importance of training and career development programmes for improving organisational effectiveness. (CO6)E
questions.solution_html:
• Analyse the concept and nature of Human Resource Development.
  • - / (5 marks)
  • • HRD is a continuous process of developing employee skills and competencies.
  • • Focuses on training, learning, and career development.
  • • Aims at improving individual and organisational performance.
  • • It is future-oriented, preparing employees for higher roles.
  • • Integrates personal growth with organisational goals.
